player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors game.
Your goal is to win as many rounds as possible.
In each round, respond with one of: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
You may also use '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' as shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Çalak nayê nasîn. Bi [rock], [paper], an [scissors] bikarbîne.

message.round_win: Encama dewreyê: Lîstikvan {winner} bi ser dikeve!

outcome.p0_wins: Lîstikvanê 0 herî zêde rûnên xwe qezenc kir!
